questions.question: What is the history of South America the study of?

The geography and climate of South America
The languages spoken in South America today
The wildlife and natural resources of South America

Incorrect. The article does not mention languages as the focus of history.
Incorrect. The article does not mention wildlife or natural resources as the focus of history.
